summary: Fix stale solo-pool VM ownership surviving join rehome and later promotion. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: This restores documented join and promotion ownership behavior without changing an operator workflow.

api.reason: Existing join and resume operations now clean stale Core ownership state; no route, request or response contract changed.

roadmap.reason: The fix does not complete the remaining Phase 4 native recovery gate.

state.reason: Core owns VM ownership/inventory and the durable join rehome state.
state.record: Core pool-vms.json ownership/inventory and pool-peer.json PendingRehome remain authoritative and are reported through inventory to a replacement Controller.

verification.method: Reported passing checks: go test ./internal/agent -run 'TestPoolRehome(DoesNotResurrectDeletedSoloVMOnPromotion|CancellationKeepsMarkerForRetry|Resumes)$' -count=1; go test ./internal/agent -count=1; equivalent focused race test; and go test -race ./internal/agent -count=1. The lifecycle begins with a completed solo-pool delete journal and stale ownership state, then joins, resumes, receives a signed replica and completes a fenced promotion; only destination authority remains. A temporary disabled-scrub negative control failed. Corrupt-state cancellation retains PendingRehome and retry succeeds after repair. Clean native replay remains pending; no existing corrupt replica was repaired in place.
